entities.summary: Founded by Constantine I in 330 CE as the new Eastern Roman capital, Constantinople was the largest and wealthiest city in Europe for nearly a thousand years. Its strategic position controlling the Bosphorus made it the crossroads of Europe and Asia. The fall to the Ottomans in 1453 ended the Byzantine Empire and reshaped Mediterranean geopolitics.
